components.name: BepInEx (custom)
components.instructions: Install official Unity.IL2CPP-win-x64 build 788, then extract CharacterSheet-0.13.38-LoaderOverlay.zip from our GitHub release over the game root. Install .NET 10.0.12 separately. No compiler is required; LoaderSource.zip supplies corresponding source. Stock build 788 alone is incompatible.

components.name: .NET game runtime
components.instructions: Download the .NET Runtime 10.0.12 Windows x64 binaries ZIP. Copy the contents of shared/Microsoft.NETCore.App/10.0.12 over the game dotnet folder. Preserve the BepInEx logging and dependency-injection DLLs.

components.name: EmberCloak
components.instructions: Extract the EmberCloak folder into BepInEx/plugins. Keep both DLLs together.

components.name: Global Metadata Restored
components.instructions: Install the restored metadata for your exact game build into Gunfire Reborn_Data/il2cpp_data/Metadata. Preserve the original file outside the game directory.
